profile.headline: Staff Engineer @ world.org
profile.summary: I learned how to code at eight and joined a large company as a full-time engineer at 19. Engineer with extensive experience living in San Francisco, building something new!

positions.title: Co-Founder
positions.description:
Dawn enables a seamless experience when using dapps with its powerful Safari Extension. No need for inbuilt browsers. Raised +$2m. Acquired by world: https://world.org/blog/product/dawn-joins-tools-for-humanity-to-bring-next-generation-finance-to-world-network

Website: https://www.dawnwallet.xyz
Open Sourced our key management: https://github.com/dawnwallet/dawn-key-management

positions.title: Owner
positions.description: I relocated to San Francisco with my company, self-petitioning for my visa. At Studio Labs, I worked on self-custodial wallets like Light and Balance.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description: After joining full-time in 2015 at 19, I returned to Rakuten to relocate within the organization to San Francisco. Due to a problem with content encryption, we had to recode the player using Shaka Player (Google). I also refactored the entire app to start using Swift, transitioning away from Objective-C.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description: I helped Durcal implement new features that handled over 300K DAU.

positions.title: Creator
positions.description:
During this time, I was traveling back and forth to San Francisco to launch multiple personal projects, aiming to find product-market fit with them.

Squapp: Squapp makes it easy to share what you're up to, explore new activities, and see what your friends are doing.
Grape: A real-time location-based game that lets you see who's with you at a venue and discover who visits it the most
Roda: We aimed to solve First-Mile/Last-Mile transportation challenges with short-range electric vehicles.

After launching and not finding PMF, I decided to return to Barcelona.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description: First iOS engineer, and #4 employee. I developed the initial version that was launched to the market, attracting the first users. Square later acquired it.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description: Joined Rakuten as the youngest full-time engineer at 19. Developed a DRM-protected mobile player using PlayReady (Microsoft) and Widevine (Google) instead of the native version (Fairplay). Coded an innovative payment solution and the offline downloads feature, beating Netflix to market (https://techcrunch.com/2015/09/10/wuaki-moves-ahead-of-netflix-with-offline-downloads-starting-first-with-mobile-devices/)

positions.title: Creator
positions.description:
Launching projects since I'm 13. Primarily focused on iOS and Android applications, with full-stack experience.

Highlights: 
Series.ly: A social network to order, organize, and track your movies. Ranked #1 in 26 countries, generating over $100k in revenue.
Impossible Game: A Flash game I launched as a Facebook application, attracting 20 million users.

etc...
